what: Part K's observations in an exported instance that holds files of its own under extensions/ and a settings fragment.

k2.emit: harness emit: 32 generated surfaces; local-terms list: unavailable
k2.check: harness check: 32 generated surfaces; local-terms list: unavailable

refusals.label: It would replace an entry the kit emits
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: autoMemoryEnabled would replace the autoMemoryEnabled the kit emits: a fragment only adds

refusals.label: It names a key the merge does not define
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: unknown key env: the merge defines hooks and permissions

refusals.label: It names a permissions key the merge does not define
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: unknown key permissions.defaultMode: the merge defines allow, ask, deny

refusals.label: It would remove a list, were null read as removal
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: permissions.deny must be an array: a fragment only adds

refusals.label: A hook under PreToolUse
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: hooks.PreToolUse: a fragment adds no hook under PreToolUse, where a hook's output can rewrite a call after the kit's guards have judged it

refusals.label: A hook under SubagentStop
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: hooks.SubagentStop: a fragment adds no hook under SubagentStop, where the kit itself answers a worker's stop and an added hook's answer can take precedence over it

refusals.label: A hook under UserPromptSubmit
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: hooks.UserPromptSubmit: a fragment adds no hook under UserPromptSubmit, where a hook that blocks or fails keeps a prompt from the session, the operator's recovery controls among them

refusals.label: A hook the kit registers itself, registered again
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: hooks.Stop[0].hooks[0].command is a hook the kit registers itself: a fragment adds its own and registers none of the kit's again

refusals.label: A rule the kit emits, in another list
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: permissions.deny holds a rule the kit emits under permissions.allow (Bash(node scripts/launchpad.mjs update --publish *)): it would countermand that entry, and a fragment only adds

refusals.label: A rule with a character that cannot be seen
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: permissions.deny[0] must be a non-empty string without control or format characters

refusals.label: A hook under an event the kit registers nothing under
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: hooks.Notification: a fragment adds hooks under PermissionDenied, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, SessionStart, Stop alone

refusals.label: An entry of another shape than the kit's own
refusals.message: invalid settings fragment in .claude/settings.instance.json: hooks.Stop[0].matcher must be a non-empty string without control or format characters

times.note: milliseconds, five runs each of the instance's own emit and check as child processes; before: no fragment; after: the fragment above
